headline.purpose: Workspace identity and prominent section subjects.

title.purpose: Batch names, panel titles, and high-priority row hierarchy.

body.purpose: Explanations, descriptions, and primary reading text.

mono.purpose: Ids, commands, paths, timestamps, counts, branches, claims, and derived facts.

shadows.name: ink-tint-medium

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Decisive action with the system's scarce signal color.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:flex-start; gap:6px; cursor:pointer; font-family:var(--font-heading); font-weight:800; font-size:13px; line-height:1.2; color:var(--color-bg); background:var(--color-accent); border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:0; padding:6.8px 12px; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:var(--color-accent-600); } .ds-btn-primary:active { background:var(--color-accent-700); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Compact outlined action that stays subordinate to the record.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:flex-start; cursor:pointer; font-family:var(--font-heading); font-weight:800; font-size:13px; color:var(--color-text); background:transparent; border:1px solid var(--color-divider); border-radius:0; padding:6.8px 12px; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-text) 7%, transparent); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-text) 14%, transparent); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Terse inline action for copy, links, and low-emphasis control.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { cursor:pointer; font-family:var(--font-heading); font-weight:800; font-size:11px; letter-spacing:.05em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--color-accent-700); background:transparent; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:0; padding:4px; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-accent) 10%, transparent); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-accent) 18%, transparent); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Square record-surface field for filtering dense repository data.
components.html: <input class="ds-input-search" type="search" placeholder="Search title or id…" />
components.css: .ds-input-search { width:260px; min-height:36px; padding:6px 10px; font-family:var(--font-body); font-size:14px; color:var(--color-text); caret-color:var(--color-accent); background:var(--color-surface); border:1px solid var(--color-divider); border-radius:0; } .ds-input-search:hover { border-color:color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-text) 45%, transparent); } .ds-input-search:focus-visible { border-color:var(--color-accent); outline:2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset:0; }

components.name: Active State Tag
components.description: Lifecycle state paired with an explicit label and decisive fill.
components.css: .ds-state-active { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; padding:2px 8px; font-family:var(--font-heading); font-size:11px; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:.07em; text-transform:uppercase; white-space:nowrap; color:var(--color-bg); background:var(--color-accent-700); border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:0; }

components.name: Rail Navigation Item
components.description: Dark-rail stage navigation with step, label, description, and live count.
components.css: .ds-rail-item { width:212px; display:grid; grid-template-columns:15px 1fr auto; align-items:center; gap:9px; padding:8px 16px; cursor:pointer; text-align:left; color:var(--color-bg); background:var(--color-accent-700); border:0; border-top:1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-bg) 12%, transparent); } .ds-rail-step,.ds-rail-count { font-family:var(--font-mono); font-size:10px; } .ds-rail-label { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:1px; } .ds-rail-label b { font-family:var(--font-heading); font-size:12.5px; letter-spacing:.02em; } .ds-rail-label small { font-size:10px; } .ds-rail-count { padding:0 5px; background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-text) 28%, transparent); } .ds-rail-item:hover { background:var(--color-accent-600); } .ds-rail-item:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset:-2px; }

components.name: Task Stamp
components.description: Monospace entity identity kept separate from lifecycle state.
components.css: .ds-task-stamp { display:inline-flex; padding:0 4px; font-family:var(--font-mono); font-size:11px; font-weight:600; color:oklch(.45 .14 258); border-bottom:2px solid oklch(.55 .15 258); }

components.name: Derivation Panel
components.description: A repository-provenance chain with the current record visibly anchored.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-derivation { width:520px; color:var(--color-text); background:var(--color-surface); border:1px solid var(--color-divider); } .ds-derivation header { display:flex; align-items:baseline; gap:8px; padding:12px 16px; border-bottom:2px solid var(--color-divider); } .ds-derivation header b { font-family:var(--font-heading); font-size:11.5px; letter-spacing:.11em; } .ds-derivation header span { font-size:11px; color:color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-text) 80%, transparent); } .ds-derivation-block { display:grid; gap:5px; padding:12px 16px; background:var(--color-bg); border-block:1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-text) 22%, transparent); box-shadow:inset 5px 0 0 var(--color-accent); } .ds-derivation-block small { font-size:9px; letter-spacing:.13em; } .ds-derivation-block strong { font-size:14px; } .ds-derivation-arrow { padding:4px 0; text-align:center; font-family:var(--font-mono); } .ds-derivation p { margin:0; padding:12px 16px; font-size:12.5px; }

components.name: Run Card
components.description: Dark execution record whose label and left edge both communicate state.
components.css: .ds-run-card { width:232px; min-height:92px; display:grid; align-content:start; gap:7px; padding:11px 12px 11px 15px; text-align:left; color:var(--color-bg); background:var(--color-neutral-900); border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-bg) 25%, transparent); border-left:4px solid var(--color-accent); cursor:pointer; transition:background 120ms ease, transform 120ms ease, border-color 120ms ease; } .ds-run-top { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; } .ds-run-top code,.ds-run-card small { font-family:var(--font-mono); font-size:9.5px; color:color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-bg) 78%, transparent); } .ds-run-top em { margin-left:auto; padding:2px 8px; font-family:var(--font-mono); font-size:8.5px; font-style:normal; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.1em; color:var(--color-bg); background:var(--color-accent); } .ds-run-card strong { font-size:12.5px; line-height:1.3; } .ds-run-card:hover { background:var(--color-neutral-800); transform:translateY(-1px); } .ds-run-card:active { background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-accent) 17%, var(--color-text)); } .ds-run-card:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-bg); outline-offset:2px; }

narrative.overview:
Kotta Console is a strict, precise, dense operational surface: a ledger where intent, provenance, execution state, and human decisions are made legible at a glance. Its modernist editorial order makes the repository feel inspectable rather than abstract; information and demonstrability always outrank ornament.

The interface is hard-edged, compact, and state-first. Archive-paper grounds, repository ink, strong rules, and a scarce signal red create an austere but purposeful field. A human-readable Archivo register explains the work while a monospace register exposes ids, paths, commands, counts, and timestamps as evidence.

The anti-references are a generic Kanban board, rounded “soft SaaS” furniture, and decorative dashboard or poster elements that compete with operational truth.
keyCharacteristics: Visible modular grids and strong rules organize the screen.
One warm signal color marks urgency, activity, and decisive emphasis.
Square geometry, compact rows, and flush-left alignment keep the system exact.
Human-readable hierarchy and machine-readable provenance remain visibly distinct.
Empty, contradictory, active, review, and complete states each read without relying on color alone.

rules.name: The Signal Is Scarce Rule
rules.body: Signal Red marks an active, urgent, or structurally important fact; it never becomes ambient decoration.

rules.name: The Contrast Carries Meaning Rule
rules.body: State is never communicated by tint alone: pair color with text, border style, position, or shape.

rules.name: The Two-Register Rule
rules.body: Use Archivo to explain and prioritize; use monospace only to expose repository or runtime evidence.

rules.name: The Flush-Left Rule
rules.body: Headings, copy, row content, and labels inside wide controls align to the left edge rather than centering for decoration.

rules.name: The Grid Must Be Seen Rule
rules.body: Major structure is expressed with equal cells and strong 2px rules; whitespace supports the grid but never replaces it.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: If a border, tonal field, or attached edge can express hierarchy, use it before a shadow.

rules.name: The Zero Radius Rule
rules.body: Do not round corners anywhere in the product interface; square edges are part of the product’s identity and information density.

rules.name: The State-First Rule
rules.body: Every component must make its current state or provenance legible before it expresses personality.

dos: Do use the existing color, type, spacing, radius, and shadow tokens instead of hard-coding parallel values.
Do expose the modular grid with 2px major rules and compact 1px row separators.
Do reserve Signal Red for active, urgent, or decisive information.
Do pair Archivo hierarchy with monospace repository evidence.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus, semantic labels, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do keep state readable through wording and structure, not color alone.
donts: Don't round corners or introduce pill-shaped containers.
Don't turn the board into a generic Kanban or a collection of floating cards.
Don't center wide button labels, primary copy, or operational tables.
Don't soften major rules into whitespace-only separation or ornamental shadows.
Don't add decorative dashboard, poster, gradient, glow, or glass effects.
Don't use entity stamp colors as general-purpose accents.
